turns.text: How many swim classes does Meera have this fall and when does it end?

Splash Starts Guppies 2 has 10 Saturday classes, 9:30-10:00 AM, from September 12 to November 14, with Coach Bree at the Fremont pool. You get up to 2 make-up classes per session, booked at least 48 hours ahead.
October 31 is a Saturday, so it's on the schedule according to the registration email. I'll flag it if Splash Starts announces any changes.
My father-in-law had a knee replacement in August and is flying Pune to Seattle via Delhi at the start of October. What should we ask the airline for?

A few things to request through Skyvara or the airline: wheelchair assistance (code WCHR, for someone who can walk short distances but not long terminal walks) at every airport, including the Delhi transfer; an aisle seat so he can stand and stretch; and a seat near the lavatory if possible. Many airlines want a fitness-to-fly letter from the surgeon within a few months of joint surgery, so it's worth asking his surgeon now. Compression socks and walking the aisle every hour or two help on the long leg.
Ok. Remind me to ask Skyvara about seats when I book.
Done. When you book, I'll remind you to ask Skyvara for wheelchair assistance at all three airports and an aisle seat on the Delhi-Seattle leg.
